rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Floribunda.
Registration name: Hakuun
rows.Origin:
Bred by Niels Dines Poulsen (1919-2003) (Denmark, 1962).
Introduced in Denmark by Poulsen Roser A/S in 1962 as 'Hakuun'.
rows.Bloom: White or white blend. Mild fragrance. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Height: 18" to 2' (45 to 60cm). Width: 18" to 20" (45 to 50cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
